title: hotspots
description: A treemap of the files the question touches: tile area = lines of code, colour = how often the file changes (or how many people changed it). Files are grouped into columns (a folder, a package, a service). Give each file a file anchor (`{ repo, path }`): clicking its tile opens the file. The page embeds every anchored file whole, so a lock file, a generated file or a file that may hold secrets gets no anchor (its tile opens nothing). Not rendered when there are no files.

metric.description: What the colour shows: `changes` (commits touching the file, default) or `authors` (distinct authors).

period.description: The history window the numbers come from, e.g. “90 days”; shown in the legend.

id.description: Part id, shared with file ids; a route step can focus the column.
Part id, unique in the block; a route step can focus the tile.

lines.description: Lines of code; the tile's area.

changes.description: Commits touching the file in the period.
